dog.description_text:
Meet Olaf!

Olaf is a sweet, playful, and curious boy with a big personality! He’s friendly, confident, and loves exploring his surroundings.

Behavior with Other Dogs

Olaf has been great with my dog! They sniffed each other, got acquainted, and Olaf was perfectly relaxed and happy to coexist. He seems comfortable sharing his space with other dogs.

Eating Habits

Olaf has a healthy appetite and has been eating well with no issues.

Walks & Leash Manners

Olaf loves going on walks and exploring! He can get a little excited and tends to pull on the leash, so he’s still working on his leash manners.

Overall Personality

Olaf is an affectionate, friendly, and easygoing boy with a playful spirit. He would make a wonderful companion!

﻿Olaf is approximately 5y 9m 3d old and is fully grown at 55 pounds. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
